## Santos v Bahia preview, how to watch, kick-off time and probable line-ups

Santos host Bahia on Saturday at Vila Belmiro in round 32 of the Campeonato Brasileiro, kick-off 21:00 Brasília time.

According to Globo.com, sportv and Premiere will show the match across Brazil, with ge providing live updates.

## OneFootball Videos [...] Santos probable XI: Diógenes, Rodinei, João Alencar, Luan Peres, Barreal, Gustavo Henrique, Gabriel Bontempo, Philippe Coutinho, Everton Cebolinha, Neymar, Gabigol.

Bahia probable XI: Ronaldo, Marcos Victor, David Duarte, Marco Moreno, Luciano Juba, Acevedo, Rodrigo Nestor, Erick, Kike Oliveira, Erick Pulga, Alejo Veliz.

Referee: Sávio Pereira Sampaio (DF).
